1283-1308-1651-6441-8276.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating four 1/1 Wasp artifact creature tokens due to Anointed Procession and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping the Wasps, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
1283-1308-1651-6441-8276.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

69-539-2174-3172.easyPrerequisites:
Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Thespian's Stage and Juniper Order Druid do not have summoning sickness.
69-539-2174-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Put Patron of the Orochi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Thespian's Stage.
Activate Thespian's Stage using Patron of the Orochi's ability by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Thespian's Stage using its own ability by paying {2} and tapping it, causing it to become a copy of itself, which causes it to become a copy of Patron of the Orochi.
Repeat from step 4.
69-539-2174-3172.notes: If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {3}, this combo nets infinite mana.

3899-7388--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat

2738-2921-4871-6248.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Phenomenon Investigators, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

When Federation Field Medic dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Federation Field Medic enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

433-3861-7857.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Llanowar Scout.
Repeat.

676-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-4359.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2724-3987-4499.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Emiel the Blessed. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

5170-5686-6132-7452.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

5686-6026-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5686-6026-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Field of Souls and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2324-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2324-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

1168-1479-2841-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1168-1479-2841-6157.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1356-1651-4574-6694-6698.description:
Activate Skull of Ramos by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Skull of Ramos from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate Oracle's Vault's second ability by tapping it, exiling Skull of Ramos from the top of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn without playing its mana cost.
Cast Skull of Ramos from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rocco's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and creating a Food token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Food and Skull of Ramos, untapping Oracle's Vault.
Repeat.

1558-1721-3210.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four additional nontoken artifacts.
1558-1721-3210.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing it and four other nontoken artifacts except Codex Shredder, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Codex Shredder's second ability by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Scrap Mastery from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Mastery by paying {3}{R}{R}, exiling all artifact cards from all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all artifacts they control and return all artifacts exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat each turn.

856-2099-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

1719-1846-3525.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
1719-1846-3525.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat from step 2

801-876-3156-4763.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Impulsive Pilferer.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, targeting Koll.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

570-2645.notablePrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness. You control a permanent of each color.
570-2645.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
570-2645.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

220-428-1946-5361.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Nomads en-Kor indestructible.
You have a way to target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Auton Soldier on the battlefield as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.
220-428-1946-5361.description:
Give Nomads en-Kor indestructible, if needed, and then target Nomads en-Kor with any amount of damage.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Repeat step 2 until only 1 damage will be dealt to Nomads en-Kor.
Resolve the spell or ability, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and any remaining damage to Brash Taunter.
Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier trigger for the damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, along with Brash Taunter. Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier also trigger for the damage dealt to Brash Taunter if exactly 1 damage  was dealt to it.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing at least 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve both Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 2 damage to Nomads en-Kor, and 2 damage to Brash Taunter, if applicable.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, if applicable, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
If Brash Taunter was dealt damage, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor, dealing 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor and 1 damage to Brash Taunter.
Auton Soldier triggers twice, and Brash Taunter triggers once.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from damage dealt to Brash Taunter, dealing 2 damage to Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter triggers, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger from step 13, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Holding priority, activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, causing the next 1 damage that would be dealt to it to be dealt to Brash Taunter instead.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger from damage dealt to Nomads en-Kor in step 13, dealing 1 damage to Brash Taunter and 1 damage to Nomads en-Kor.
Repeat from step 13 one additional time, with the nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggering instead of Auton Soldier.
Repeat from step 13.

390-722-3153.notablePrerequisites: Hulking Metamorph is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
390-722-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

185-796-2103-2501-3098.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} on the first turn, with at most {6}{U}{U}{U} available each other extra turn
185-796-2103-2501-3098.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with power two or greater.
You have not cast an instant or sorcery this turn.
185-796-2103-2501-3098.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U} and sacrificing a creaature with power two or greater.
Capture of Jingzhou's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Capture of Jingzhou trigger, copying it.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Capture of Jingzhous, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your last extra turn.
Cast Call to Mind by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing a Zombie, targeting Mystic Retrieval.
Call to Mind's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Call to Mind trigger, copying it, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Call to Minds, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {3}{U} and sacrificing a Zombie, targeting Call to Mind.
Mystic Retrieval's casualty ability and Poppet Stitcher trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Retrieval trigger, copying it, targeting Capture of Jingzhou.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve both Mystic Retrievals, returning Capture of Jingzhou and Call to Mind from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat steps 1 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 7.

708-2019-3771-4050.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast The Prismatic Piper for {0} due to Animar and Myth Unbound.
708-2019-3771-4050.description:
Cast The Prismatic Piper from the command zone by paying {0}.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Prismatic Piper, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have The Prismatic Piper return to the command zone.
Myth Unbound triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1283-1518-1987-3227.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1283-1518-1987-3227.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Scrivener, blinking them.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
